name: neatlogs
description: AI agent skills for NeatLogs — the observability and tracing platform for LLM and AI agent applications.

plugins.name: neatlogs-py
plugins.description: Instrument Python LLM applications with the neatlogs SDK — tracing, semantic spans, supported wrappers and framework integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, CrewAI, and more.

plugins.name: neatlogs-ts
plugins.description: Instrument TypeScript/Node.js LLM applications with the neatlogs SDK — semantic spans, supported wrappers and framework integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK, and more.

plugins.name: neatlogs-go
plugins.description: Instrument Go LLM applications with the neatlogs SDK — Gemini via WrapGenAI, direct or unsupported providers via explicit span helpers, custom boundaries, and per-request identity.

plugins.name: neatlogs-ingest
plugins.description: Send traces to Neatlogs from unsupported languages with dependency-free HTTP ingest at POST /v1/trace, or configure OTLP/gRPC for existing OpenTelemetry applications and Collectors.
